target.conversion_field: episode_success is derived from failure_detection; not separately validated mechanical final success

grouping: canonical task and exact duplicate components; no session/operator/robot independence claimed

visual.frame_rule: round(linspace(0,N-1,16)); assert unique and ordered; no annotation-keyframe access
visual.pooling: spatial mean of stage2,stage3,stage4 maps; concatenate128+256+512; temporal arithmetic mean
visual.head: Linear(896,128),ReLU,Dropout(0.1),Linear(128,1)
visual.budget_sharing: A single50-epoch trajectory per rule/seed/fit can preserve independently selected <=25 and <=50 checkpoints; shared cosine50 prefix explicitly reported
visual.selection: highest V AP within budget; tie lower weighted V BCE then earliest epoch
visual.normalizer: fixed initial-backbone target T feature mean/std only; no source-domain feature moments transferred
visual.precision: float32 reference until numerical parity is demonstrated

sensors.measurement_semantics: native observed position/velocity and two gripper-effort fields; not force/torque
sensors.interval: complete same original episode; no frame-level labels inferred
sensors.normalization: T only; preserve feature behavior in reassemble.section1_features.statistics
sensors.calibration: unweighted sigmoid LogisticRegression C1 on C raw scores; same procedure for visual/sensor

fusion.F2: unweighted LogisticRegression C1 on two calibrated inner-OOF probabilities; newly fit per visual/sensor condition/seed/outer fold
fusion.quality_gate: reuse DecisionGate F5 quality-only context; hidden16,ReLU,two outputs,masked softmax; convex mixture of clipped branch logits
fusion.gate_training: fixed40 epochs,AdamW lr0.003 weight_decay0.001; unweighted BCE; no test-selected settings
quality_inputs: sampled RGB blur/brightness/contrast and decode coverage
fusion.meta_selection: F2/gate fixed a priori; changing hyperparameters requires deeper nested, group-safe branch regeneration

metrics.report: all outer folds and seeds plus pooled OOF; paired deltas and prevalence; no best-fold/seed selection
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 paired canonical-task-cluster bootstrap replicates of mean per-seed metric differences; seeds/folds not independent replicates

optional_source_transfer.source_selection: Fixed existing REASSEMBLE validation selection; never choose using ViFailback outer tests
optional_source_transfer.load: compatible backbone tensors only; discard head, feature moments, calibrators, F2 and gate weights
optional_source_transfer.comparison: P/R share cohort, T/V/C/assessment, target heads, budget/freezing rule, seeds, metrics; same source checkpoint across target seeds

optional_camera_extension: All three cameras at the same16 positions =48 images, explicitly separate from primary16-image contract; same primary cohort and no test-driven camera selection
